==========================================================
Coram:Honourable Ms. Justice Nisha M. Thakore Date : 12/07/2023
Farad
"For the reasons recorded in the judgment, I am of the view that the learned Sessions Judge committed error in recording the order of acquittal in case of respondent No.1.

Thus, the judgment and order of acquittal dated 21.03.2007 passed by the learned Additional Sessions Judge and Presiding Officer, 7 th Fast Track Court, Rajkot in Criminal Appeal No.4 of 1999 is hereby quashed and set aside.

This Court finds that the date of incident of offence is of the year 1991, pending the trial, the original appellant - original accused No.2 had expired, who happens to be real brother of respondent No.2 - original accused No.1.
This Court finds that the accused No.1 is license holder under the Act and was responsible to strictly adhere to the provisions of the Rules provided under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act.

Since substantial years have R/CR.A/2265/2009 FARAD DATED: 12/07/2023 passed, this Court finds that the interest of justice would prevail by imposing a fine amount of Rs.5,000/- upon respondent No.2 - original accused No.1.
Let such amount be deposited with the concerned Court within a period of one month from the date of receipt of this order.
Record and Proceedings to be sent back to the concerned trial Court."
